The discussion qualifies trading risk and advises smaller amounts or analysis instead of immediate trading, without presenting a guaranteed return or documented transaction. Broker links, partner codes, and deposit-bonus wording are promotional material, but the available video evidence does not establish deceptive conduct, completed registration, or a loss.
